exposure: Universal offering of an oral glucose tolerance test (OGTT)
Selective risk factor based offering of an oral glucose tolerance test (OGTT)
selective risk factor-based offering of OGTT
cohort: 35,674 births at the Women's and Newborn unit, Bradford Royal Infirmary, United Kingdom over a 6-year period
finding: Universal offering of an OGTT was associated with increased identification of women with GDM and severe hyperglycemia, and with reduced rates of cesarean section, macrosomia, and perinatal mortality among women with GDM.
